flows:
Navigate to http://127.0.0.1:4173/ then Open Hati and clear any saved data so the app starts empty.
Add a person named Ana.
Add a person named Ben.
Add a person named Cy.
Add a bill with amount 1,000.00 paid by Ana, split equally between Ana, Ben and Cy, then view the per-person shares.
Assert Ana's share shows 333.34.
Assert Ben's share shows 333.33.
Assert Cy's share shows 333.33.
Store the three shares shown for Ana, Ben and Cy, in that order, as visible text as {{equal_split_shares}}.
